name: xstate
description_en: State machines, statecharts, and actors for complex logic
readme_excerpt: Actor-based state management & orchestration for complex app logic. → Documentation XState is a state management and orchestration solution for JavaScript and TypeScript apps. It has zero dependencies, and is useful for frontend and backend application logic. It uses event-driven programming, state machines, statecharts, and the actor model to handle complex logic in predictable, robust, and visual ways. XState provides a powerful and flexible way to manage application and workflow state by all…
